rule: Menu placement in the UI has exactly one mutation path: MatrixApp::apply_panel_op.
banned_token_source: the six tokens come from the fixture N34-source-scan-single-door; the two extra height/visibility mutators come from the design review (MEDIUM 4)

allowlist.DockLayout::section: read one menu state (13 call sites)
allowlist.DockLayout::resolve: resolve panel sizes for the frame
allowlist.DockLayout::reset_to_default: Reset Menus / Reload Menus baseline; an active drag is cancelled
allowlist.DockLayout::save: Set as Default, the documented writer
allowlist.DockLayout::set_float / set_size / set_v: panel geometry (command search, rail, docks), never menu placement

removed_from_the_ui: the 28 px right-drop-zone overlay (compute_right_drop_zone, right_drop_zone_ui, right_drop_zone_rect, RIGHT_DROP_ZONE_WIDTH) and the pointer-less settle_section_drag
positive_check: the N34 test also requires every self.dock.<method>( in ui.rs, ui/chrome.rs and ui/panel_audit.rs to be on this allowlist, so a new bypass cannot slip in unnoticed
